nature_language: 当前位置南京。我三个人想去广州玩两天，预算6000人民币，坐火车往返，住两间房，麻烦给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Nanjing. Three of us want to visit Guangzhou for two days with a budget of 6,000 RMB. We plan to travel round-trip by train and stay in two rooms. Could you please provide a travel itinerary for us?
